name: investment-toolkit-plugins
description: Investment Toolkit plugins: AI stock valuation, portfolio advisor (health, rebalancing, strategy review), and suite orchestration.

plugins.name: stock-valuation
plugins.description: AI-driven autonomous stock valuation and research engine. Skills: /evaluate-stock (Bear/Base/Bull DCF projections with analyticsLog), /research-stock (qualitative sweep with Class A/B/C/D change classification and decision gate before re-valuation), /forward-valuation-challenge (stress-test valuations against trailing financials), /valuation-math-validation (deterministic DCF math and spread checks).

plugins.name: portfolio-advisor
plugins.description: Investment portfolio advisor suite. Flagship /daily interactive loop. Skills: /stock-intake, /portfolio-coverage-audit, /weekly-review, /data-quality-audit, /review-portfolio, /strategic-review, /rebalance, /calibrate-targets, /update-portfolio-targets, /x-news-sweep, /adversarial-review, /bundle-thesis-review, /13f-tracker, /13f-analyze, /norberts-gambit, /ytd-return, /set-thesis-breakers. Agents: daily-loop-agent, portfolio-advisor-orchestrator, red-team-agent, risk-officer-agent.

plugins.name: toolkit-manager
plugins.description: Master orchestrator plugin for InvestmentToolkit. Features /toolkit-onboarding (Master Portfolio Bootstrap Wizard — guides zero-config installation, account & pillar architecture, broker ingestion, automated DCF baseline, and live TradingView visual sync) and /start-screener.

plugins.name: etf-analysis
plugins.description: AI-driven ETF and fund analysis engine. Three fund types: CLOSED_END, THEMATIC_ETF, CASH_FUND. Trigger: /analyze-etf {TICKER}.

plugins.name: tradingview
plugins.description: TradingView Desktop integration via CDP. Skills: /tv-portfolio-sync, /tv-indicators, /tv-thesis-overlay, /tv-alert-reconcile, /tv-ta, /tv-ta-deep, /tv-ta-daily-sweep, /tv-snapshot, /tv-price-refresh, /tv-alert-sync, /tv-pine-inject, /tv-author-pine, /tv-chart-setup, /tv-change-symbol, /tv-change-type, /tv-draw, /tv-manage-watchlists, /tv-place-order, /tv-modify-order, /tv-cancel-order, /tv-get-orders, /tv-setup, /tv-onboarding. Agents: ta-guide. Requires TV Desktop with --remote-debugging-port=9222.

plugins.name: questrade
plugins.description: Questrade Brokerage Model Context Protocol (MCP) integration. Skills: /questrade-setup (interactive OAuth setup), /questrade-sync (multi-account balance and holdings sync into SQLite), /questrade-order-draft (Human-in-the-Loop draft orders with phone push approval), /questrade-activities (dividend and cash flow ledger).
